headline.caveat: $38B over 7 years (Nov 2025) + $100B over 8 years expansion agreed alongside Amazon's $50B equity (2026)

realized_to_date.caveat: consumption began immediately in Nov 2025 on existing AWS capacity; amounts consumed not disclosed

nature_md: OpenAI's first non-Microsoft hyperscaler contract, signed Nov 3, 2025 days after Azure exclusivity ended: $38B over ~7 years for AWS compute — hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA GB200/GB300 GPUs in EC2 UltraServer clusters, with capacity targeted for full deployment by end-2026 and expansion into 2027+. Expanded by a further $100B over 8 years as part of the Feb 2026 round in which Amazon invested $50B in OpenAI (completed Jul 31, 2026) — equity and compute contracted together. Makes Amazon simultaneously OpenAI's shareholder, supplier, and (via Bedrock model distribution) channel partner.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Compute purchase commitment expensed as consumed; adds ~$138B to OpenAI's stack of forward obligations across Microsoft ($250B), Oracle (~$300B), CoreWeave (~$22.4B), and others — all payable from capital not yet raised.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: AWS books revenue as consumed and the commitment into backlog (AWS backlog ~$496B mid-2026). Amazon's $50B equity stake means a portion of OpenAI's payments are funded, at one remove, by Amazon's own investment — the round-trip pattern, though the contracts predate and exceed the equity.
